fixture.exact_input: Create the first deployable slice for a synthetic model-driven service-request solution. An authorised service agent must create one request with required title, category, and priority, save it through the model-driven app, receive clear success or validation feedback, and leave privacy-safe telemetry and evidence. Use one solution-owned Dataverse table, no integration or AI, least-privilege access, and separate local, deployment, and runtime proof. Produce deployment prerequisites and rollback notes, but do not implement or deploy.
